body:
Hello,

My name is Ronnie Shure, Founder & CEO of Dog Tag Day Foundation. We are building April 18 into a national day of veteran visibility.

Dog Tag Day asks Americans to recognize the person behind the dog tags, listen to veterans’ stories, and acknowledge their service. The dog tags mean “I served.” Acknowledging them means “I see you.”

We would welcome a conversation about how Dog Tag Day Foundation can help your organization and how we might support one another as April 18 grows nationally.

Please visit DogTagDay.org to learn more.

Respectfully,
Ronnie Shure
Founder & CEO
Dog Tag Day Foundation
DogTagDay.org
